items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: Billy Shaw took me over there, Billy Shaw was with the William Morris Agency, he picked me up and that's when I got into the real big money.

ctx.x: As long as you got a decent taste on the job--you usually got a pretty good taste of money on the job when you were playing.

Yeah, I got nice money. Then after "Amen" I got fantastic money, to what I'd been making. You see, after we went into--after we came out of McGuinney's, I went--Billy Shaw took me over there, Billy Shaw was with the William Morris Agency, he picked me up and that's when I got into the real big money.
